title: feat(service-messaging): the notification preference quiet_hours declares the quiet-hours widget
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X9QaksZP89FVq2pH6CVzsEb)_

Fixes #31426

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：通知偏好的「免打扰」字段 `quiet_hours` 加上 `widget: 'quiet-hours'`，控制台改用时区加两个时间的控件，不再显示 JSON 编辑框；存储格式不变。
- 为什么改：#31421 的前端控件（PR #31459，已合并）只认字段上的 widget 提示，和同一对象的 topic、channel 一样，这是它的服务端一半。
- 风险与回滚：只是一个界面提示，不改字段类型、不新增拒绝；未注册该控件的宿主照旧显示 JSON 编辑框。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-messaging/src/objects/notification-preference.object.ts` 的 `quiet_hours`。
- 两分钟验证：`cd packages/services/service-messaging && npx vitest run src/objects/notification-preference-topic-channel-help.test.ts`，预期 5 个全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `sys_notification_preference.quiet_hours` declares `widget: 'quiet-hours'`, with a `[#30208 row 6, #31426]` comment like the ones on `topic` and `channel`. The field stays `json`; the stored shape `{ tz?, start: 'HH:MM', end: 'HH:MM' }` and every refusal are unchanged. The ui half registers `field:quiet-hours` (PR #31459, merged).
- `content/docs/data-modeling/field-types.mdx` gains a short section on the three notification preference widgets (`notification-topic`, `notification-channel`, `quiet-hours`): which field each sits on, what it draws, what it stores, and that an unregistered name falls back to the type's default input. Per the ui seat's note on the card, the topic and channel hints were undocumented until now.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/service-messaging` patch.

## Tests

- `notification-preference-topic-channel-help.test.ts` (the file that pins the `topic` / `channel` hints) adds: `quiet_hours` declares `widget: 'quiet-hours'` and stays `json`.
